snippet.title: Folk Tales Alageyik Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Teaser Trailer is out now! Step into the haunting and mysterious world:
Folk Tales: Alageyik is an action-horror game. It follows a hunter who, after experiencing a nightmare, is chased by a deer he has repeatedly killed. 

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763830/Folk_Tales_Ala_Geyik/
